headline: Iran resumes missile attacks as U.S. and Saudis strike Tehran-backed militias in Iraq
context: The flare-up on multiple fronts raised the risk of a return to all-out war, underscoring the difficulty of winding down a five-month conflict that has jolted the world economy.
